# Fetch comments for each incomplete task to see who agreed to take them.
task_ids = [2851, 2854, 2861, 2865, 2867, 2871, 2886]
access_token = login_result['access_token']
comments_by_task = {}
for tid in task_ids:
    all_comments = []
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        page = apis.todoist.show_task_comments(task_id=tid, access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        # page is a list of comments
        all_comments.extend(page)
        if len(page) < 20:
            break
        page_index += 1
    comments_by_task[tid] = all_comments
    print(f"Task {tid} comments:")
    for c in all_comments:
        print(f"  user={c['user']['name']} email={c['user']['email']} content={c['content']}")
    print()
